title: Meditations
reason: As a student of constitutional law with an analytical disposition and high regard for foundational moral and ethical frameworks, I find Marcus Aurelius's Meditations directly relevant to my work. The text addresses moral virtue, human rationality, and principles of governance — themes that underpin constitutional reasoning. It is compact, rigorously structured, and has been consulted by statesmen and jurists across centuries. The price at £25.89 is entirely reasonable for a Penguin Classics edition of a text of this stature. Furthermore, its Stoic emphasis on security, self-discipline, and resilience aligns precisely with my personal values.
